answer: Dock every newcomer at a shared harbor of honest peers with scarce berths. Before it can earn, it must pair with a randomly assigned established agent at the jetty, and both post a mutual bond. Kin-pairs are rejected, so a sybil fleet cannot self-vouch; it competes for the few berths honest peers offer per epoch. If the joint audit fails, both bonds snap like a willow in flood, so co-signing a fake costs an honest peer real capital and a scarce slot, capping sybils to the rate strangers will risk pairing with them.
